text: dsh-advisor 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的回合顾问插件。它在每个 turn/end 事件后整理近期会话内容并调用当前或指定的模型评估；非正常或偏离目标的反馈会写入会话，再由浏览器端渲染为聊天建议卡片。卡片呈现 verdict、问题和建议，正常结果保持静默；可选配置允许顾问建议触发主 agent 继续处理。适合希望在 DSH 对话中获得额外任务检查和下一步建议的用户。需要可用的 DSH 模型路由。

dsh-advisor reviews DSH turns with the current or configured model. It records non-OK feedback and shows verdicts, issues, and advice in the Web chat; OK results stay silent. Optional auto-continuation can wake the main agent. Requires a working DSH model route.
想让 DSH 在每轮结束后检查任务有没有遗漏。
DSH 对话结束时能不能给我指出问题和下一步建议？
I want an extra model review of each DSH turn with actionable feedback.
dsh-advisor 的功能「回合建议卡片」：监听会话回合结束并用模型评估近期消息；有问题或建议时记录反馈，Web 聊天界面显示 verdict、问题列表和建议内容。正常 verdict 不显示卡片。

dsh-advisor README · Introduction：

dsh-advisor

Turn advisor for DSH — evaluates each turn (default: on error) via LLM and renders a full-width light-blue advice card in the chat.

dsh-advisor README · Introduction：A host+client bundle plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness). The host half listens to `session/event` for `turn/end`, calls `ctx.llm.stream()` with a configurable prompt, and appends `advisor/eval` (log-only). The browser half registers a `ConversationNodeDefinition` for `advisor/eval` and a keyed `conversation.chat.node` renderer (`advisor`) — a full-width card in harmonious blue (#e3eefc/#3b6ea5, no traffic-light colors) with verdict icon differentiation.

dsh-advisor README · Introduction：- **Log-only evaluation.** The verdict is appended as `advisor/eval` — a log-only node with no surfaceOp, so the agent never sees it.
- **Errors by default.** `evaluateOn: ['error']` (default) means only failed turns cost an LLM call; `['all']` opts into every turn.
- **Harmonious, not alarming.** One blue family (#e3eefc / #3b6ea5) with icon-only verdict differentiation — no red/yellow/green traffic lights.
- **One-line install.** Built `lib/` is committed, so `dsh plugin add` works without a build step.

dsh-advisor README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:haoliangwu/dsh-advisor
```

Built `lib/` is committed, so the git install is one line — no `prepare` script, no `allowBuilds` permission. Restart `dsh --profile web` after install (bundle layer stacks compose at boot).

dsh-advisor README · Configure：In your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: dsh-advisor
  config:
    # When to evaluate: ['error'] (default) or ['all']
    evaluateOn: ['error']

`evaluateOn` accepts any `turn/end` reason kind (`completed`, `error`, `aborted`, `blocked`, `max-tokens`, `interrupted`) or `all`. An empty list disables evaluation.

dsh-advisor README · Configure：`promptTemplate` defaults to a hard-coded JSON template that requests `{"verdict":"ok"|"needs-attention"|"off-track","issues":[],"advice":"..."}`. JSON parse failures degrade to `needs-attention` with advice set to raw output.

Disable entirely:

```yaml
- id: dsh-advisor
  disabled: true
```

dsh-advisor README · How it works：- **Host:** `ctx.on('session/event')` filters `turn/end` by `evaluateOn`; builds a short transcript from `session.deriveMessages()` (last 10) and the `requestHeader`/`requestContext` route (or explicit `provider`/`model`); calls `ctx.llm.stream()` and parses verdict/issues/advice; appends `advisor/eval` log-only (no surfaceOp, ignorable).
- **Client:** `ConversationNodeDefinition` (`kind: advisor`, `target: chat`) matches `advisor/eval` per turn and builds a `chatNode('advisor', …)`; `AdvisorCard` renders a full-width light-blue card with blue-family icons (○ / ◐ / ◉) and locale-aware verdict labels (`advisor` namespace, zh/en).
- **Card styling:** background `#e3eefc`, border `#c3dbf5`, text `#3b6ea5` family; icon variants differentiate verdicts within the same hue (light fill → solid fill), never red/yellow/green.

dsh-advisor README · Build from source：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build         # emits lib/index.js, lib/invariant.js, lib/client.js + sourcemaps
pnpm typecheck     # tsc --noEmit
```

`lib/` is committed so git installs work without a build step. After changing source, run `pnpm build` and commit the updated `lib/`.
